svg.text: Threshold 0.5 | GroupKFold by perfume_id | five random perfume-order seeds
The previous LR/XGBoost sweep already used balanced model settings; this isolates their effect.
Balancing improves macro F1 for both models because it makes the models predict rare labels more often, especially sadness and disgust. It is not a free improvement on every metric: common-label F1
can drop, and PR-AUC changes are small or mixed because ranking quality is mostly unchanged.
The balanced rows are therefore the right advisor-facing default for macro-F1 reporting, while the ablation explains why macro F1 is sensitive to label imbalance.
Macro F1 mean across five perfume-order seeds
Positive F1 Delta means the balanced model improved that label's F1 over its unbalanced counterpart. Large gains on sadness and disgust show the imbalance correction is doing what it is supposed to
Negative deltas for anticipation and some LR joy results mean balancing can reduce performance on labels that were already easier or more common. The macro score still improves because rare labels
Status: balancing ablation complete for the full synthetic-only 784x6 corpus at threshold 0.5.
